result:
The newsletter sign-up now lives as its own module under `modules/newsletter/`, and a new architecture rule stops the blog from depending on it. `bun run typecheck`, `bun test`, `bunx guren check` and `bunx guren check --arch` all pass with no failures (the warnings are the existing ones about missing controller test files). The full `bunx guren gate` passes too.

To confirm the rule works, I added two throwaway files: one under `app/` importing `modules/newsletter/index.ts`, and one under `routes/` importing `modules/newsletter/db/schema.ts`. `guren check` reported both as failures, and I then deleted them.

I scaffolded the module with `bunx guren make:module newsletter`, which also made two changes outside the module:
- **`src/app.ts`** now loads it with `modules: [newsletterModule]`.
- **`db/schema.ts`** now re-exports the module's table so the usual migrate command picks it up. `db/` is outside the boundary, and `guren check` expects this link.

The endpoints:
- **Subscribe** (`POST /newsletter/subscribe`): stores the email with a random 64-character token and no confirmation date, then redirects to the `Referer` page, or to `/` if the `Referer` is missing or points to another site. A bad or already-subscribed email gets a 422 with the error under `email`, and nothing is written.
- **Confirm** (`GET /newsletter/confirm/:token`): sets the confirmation date and redirects to `/`. A token we never issued gets a 404 and changes nothing.
- **Unsubscribe** (`POST /newsletter/unsubscribe`): deletes that one row and redirects back the same way as subscribe.

Emails are trimmed and lowercased before saving, so `Reader@Example.com` and `reader@example.com` count as the same subscriber.

In summary: I created `modules/newsletter/` with `index.ts`, `routes.ts`, `db/schema.ts` (the `newsletter_subscriptions` table with unique `email` and `token`), a `NewsletterSubscription` model, a `NewsletterEmailSchema` validator, a `NewsletterController` with the three actions, and `tests/NewsletterController.test.ts` covering the contract cases. I added the migration `db/migrations/20260925021305_add_newsletter_subscriptions/` and a root `guren.arch.ts`, which forbids any file under `app/` or `routes/` from importing `modules/newsletter/`, including type-only imports. Nothing under `app/` or `routes/` changed.
